items.briefing:
Cyber attacks in Australia rose 16% last month, with ransomware driving much of the increase. This means Australian organisations — including training providers — face a growing risk of having their systems locked or data stolen. Separately, security leaders report being more concerned than their own staff about the risks posed by AI tools, highlighting a gap in awareness that could leave organisations exposed.

**Practical tip:** Remind staff not to use personal or unapproved AI tools for work tasks — check with your IT or management team before using any new AI application.

featured.title: Cyber attacks rise 16% as ransomware surges in July
featured.quote: Ransomware surge threatens Australian organisations with escalating cyber attack frequency and severity.
